body: DECLARE x int; BEGIN x := (SELECT count(*) FROM t); END
DECLARE msg text; BEGIN msg := 'hello'; END
DECLARE x int; BEGIN x := lower(y); END
DECLARE x int; BEGIN NULL; x := 1; NULL; END
DECLARE x int; BEGIN x := 1; END

comment: assignment to a positional parameter ($N) is captured as text

body: DECLARE arr int[]; BEGIN arr[1] := 5; END
DECLARE m int[]; x int; BEGIN m[i][j] := x + 1; END

comment: subscripted target on a compound name is captured as text
trailing block comment is excluded from the captured expression
body: DECLARE x int; BEGIN x := 1 /* hi */; END

comment: trailing line comment is excluded (deparse re-parses cleanly)
